t: Forging a Causal Anchor: My War Against Tech Churn
s: This article chronicles a decades-long journey rejecting modern web's 'dependency churn' in favor of a stable, timeless tech stack (LPvg + HTMX) to achieve durable development environments, personified as a 'Causal Anchor'.
sub: Personal philosophy of rejecting 'dependency churn' for stability
Evolution of web development tools and the 'tyranny of the build process'
The 'LPvg' (Linux, Python, vim, git) stack as a foundation for timelessness
HTMX as the 'Webfullstackectomy' solution to simplify the web UI with Python
